decisions.reason: The format plug-in line extends the established offer, has its own page and costs little to maintain, so keeping the option open remains cheap while demand evidence accumulates.

The building digital twin service is still only lightly visible and its value is uncertain, but the field is emerging and holding the option costs little, so one more year of evidence is worth waiting for.
The authentication and delegation service overlaps with the identity service E and could be folded into it, but it is close to the core offer and cheap to keep, so abandoning it is not yet justified.
The open GIS framework underpins the firm's component, research and standards strategy, giving it high strategic option value at low marginal cost.
The identity service was actively announced and integrates GIS applications seamlessly, which signals commitment and favourable early prospects that justify continued investment.
The newly launched consulting workshop has its own page, builds on existing expertise, costs little to offer and is too new to judge, so the option should stay open.
